instruction: List all DNS zones in a Cloudflare account
output: gcloud dns managed-zones list

instruction: Add a DNS A record in Cloudflare
output:
ID: dns_record_abc123
Type: A
Name: www.example.com
Content: 93.184.216.34
TTL: 1 (Auto)
Proxied: true

Record created. Proxied traffic will be protected by Cloudflare.

instruction: List DNS records for a Cloudflare zone
output:
ID                                Type  Name                    Content              TTL  Proxied
---------------------------------  ----  ----------------------  -------------------  ---  -------
dns_record_abc123                A     www.example.com         93.184.216.34        Auto true
dns_record_def456                MX    example.com             10 mail.example.com  Auto false
dns_record_ghi789                TXT   example.com             v=spf1 mx ~all       1200 false
dns_record_jkl012                CNAME api.example.com         api-backend.example.com Auto true

4 records found for zone example.com.

instruction: Delete a DNS record from Cloudflare
output:
Record dns_record_abc123 deleted from zone example.com.

Use flarectl dns delete --zone example.com --id <record_id> to remove a record.

instruction: Update a DNS record in Cloudflare
output:
Record dns_record_def456 updated.
Old content: 10 mail.old-server.com
New content: 10 mail.new-server.com

The MX record has been updated to point to the new mail server.

instruction: Create a DNS challenge record for certbot with Cloudflare
output: certbot certonly --dns-cloudflare --dns-cloudflare-credentials ~/.cloudflare/credentials.ini -d example.com

instruction: Run certbot with the DNS-01 challenge using a manual hook
output: certbot certonly --dns-cloudflare --dns-cloudflare-credentials ~/.cloudflare/credentials.ini -d example.com --preferred-challenges dns-01

instruction: Renew a certificate using certbot DNS challenge
output: certbot renew --dns-cloudflare --dns-cloudflare-credentials ~/.cloudflare/credentials.ini

instruction: Request a wildcard certificate with DNS challenge
output:
Saving debug log to /var/log/letsencrypt/letsencrypt.log
Requesting a certificate for *.example.com

- Validating for *.example.com
- Cloudflare DNS: adding TXT record for _acme-challenge.example.com
- Challenge passed
- Certificate issued for: *.example.com
- Certificate path: /etc/letsencrypt/live/example.com-0001/fullchain.pem

Wildcard certificates require DNS-01 challenge method.

instruction: Send a DNS query using Scapy
output: scapy_dns_query example.com

instruction: Perform a DNS MX query using Scapy
output:
>>> ans = sr1(IP(dst="8.8.8.8")/UDP(dport=53)/DNS(rd=1,qd=DNSQR(qname="example.com",qtype="MX")),timeout=2)
>>> ans[DNS].an.rdata
'10 mail.example.com'

MX preference value: 10, Mail server: mail.example.com.

instruction: Perform a DNS reverse lookup using Scapy
output:
>>> from scapy.all import *
>>> ans = sr1(IP(dst="8.8.8.8")/UDP(dport=53)/DNS(rd=1,qd=DNSQR(qname="34.216.184.93.in-addr.arpa",qtype="PTR")),timeout=2)
>>> ans[DNS].an.rdata
'example.com.'

Reverse DNS lookup resolved the IP to example.com.

instruction: Perform a DNSSEC query using Scapy
output:
>>> ans = sr1(IP(dst="8.8.8.8")/UDP(dport=53)/DNS(rd=1,qd=DNSQR(qname="example.com",qtype="DNSKEY")),timeout=2)
>>> ans[DNS].an.rdata
'257 3 13 0123456789abcdef...'

DNSKEY record with flags=257, protocol=3, algorithm=13 (ECDSAP256SHA256).

instruction: Run certbot with the DNS-01 challenge using Route53
output: certbot certonly --dns-route53 -d example.com

instruction: Run certbot with DNS challenge using DigitalOcean
output: certbot certonly --dns-digitalocean --dns-digitalocean-credentials ~/.digitalocean/credentials.ini -d example.com

instruction: Use flarectl to export all DNS records
output:
Records exported to example.com-export.json

The export contains all DNS records for the zone in JSON format.

instruction: Send a DNS TXT query using Scapy
output:
>>> ans = sr1(IP(dst="8.8.8.8")/UDP(dport=53)/DNS(rd=1,qd=DNSQR(qname="example.com",qtype="TXT")),timeout=2)
>>> ans[DNS].an.rdata
[b'v=spf1 mx ~all']

TXT record retrieved successfully using a raw Scapy DNS query.

instruction: Perform a DNS zone walk simulation using Scapy
output:
>>> ans = sr1(IP(dst="8.8.8.8")/UDP(dport=53)/DNS(rd=1,qd=DNSQR(qname="example.com",qtype="NSEC")),timeout=2)
>>> ans.show()

instruction: Set up certbot DNS challenge via manual mode with a hook script
output: certbot certonly --manual --preferred-challenges dns -d example.com --manual-auth-hook /usr/local/bin/auth-hook.sh
